channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'
item.description: Goldman economist Joseph Briggs said broader pessimism in society may be contributing to struggling consumer sentiment even as the economy chugs along.

item.title: MS NOW, CNN and Politico journalists blocked from White House after Trump ban
item.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House, one day after Trump banned three media outlets over their coverage of him.

item.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
item.description: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.

item.title: Flames reported near Saudi capital airport as Pakistan presses Iran over energy supplies
item.description: Smoke and flames were seen near Riyadh’s main airport after Saudi civil-defense alerts, while Pakistan urged Iran to protect energy supplies and shipping.

item.title: Google's Gemini becomes latest AI model to break out and hack computer systems
item.description: The disclosure comes as scrutiny over misbehaving artificial intelligence intensifies in Washington and Silicon Valley.

item.title: The S&P 500 just logged another losing week, yet these stocks could be due for a bounce
item.description: Another losing week has dragged certain individual stocks to levels where they might find some support.

item.title: Paramount could settle with states over Warner Bros. as soon as this weekend, sources say
item.description: A settlement this week could help Paramount avoid paying millions of dollars in fees to Warner Bros. shareholders, Reuters reported.

item.title: U.S. judge signals rejection of part of TikTok $400 million privacy settlement
item.description: TikTok agreed to pay $300 million and a further $100 million if a court terminated a 2019 consent decree imposed by the FTC on TikTok's predecessor, Musical.ly.

item.title: Buffett takes next step in plan to keep Berkshire from straying
item.description: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman, passing the job to his son, Howard.

item.title: Student loan borrowers exiting SAVE may face sharply higher payments if they don't take action soon
item.description: Millions of student loan borrowers could see their monthly bills skyrocket if they don't move into an affordable repayment plan soon. Here's what to know.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI need truly independent safety evaluators, experts say in public letter
item.description: A coalition of over 100 AI experts are urging independence and transparency from Anthropic, OpenAI and other foundation model labs to conduct evaluations.

item.title: AI safety debate meets reality at Dreamforce as business leaders say last year's models are enough
item.description: At Salesforce's annual mega-conference in San Francisco, attendees said they get enough value from older AI models.

item.title: She pays $96 a month to live in Yellowstone National Park: 'Being here has changed my life'
item.description: Zoe De La Paz quit her corporate job in Chicago and in June moved to Yellowstone to work as a seamstress.

item.title: Tokenization is set to change stock trading. These stocks could get a boost
item.description: Digital exchanges are rocketing upward in Friday morning trading after regulatory changes that follow the failure of the Clarity Act in Congress.

item.title: A new arms race is unfolding on the ocean floor
item.description: Countries and companies are investing in technologies for underwater use amid concerns about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure on the ocean floor.

item.title: Dow falls Friday and posts worst week since March as Treasury yields rise: Live updates
item.description: The Dow Industrials slid on Friday and notched a third straight losing week.

item.title: The Fed rate hike opens up an opportunity for muni bond investors
item.description: Here's where the experts now see opportunities in the municipal market.

item.title: OpenAI's latest AI revelation is a 'serious situation,' Microsoft's Suleyman tells CNBC
item.description: Suleyman joined "Squawk Box" to discuss OpenAI's latest incidents of "concerning model behavior" disclosed earlier this week.

item.title: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
item.description: The chairman both explained this week's decision to raise interest rates, and raised vexing questions about what comes next

item.title: Cramer’s week ahead: What to watch as Wall Street navigates a tough September
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors could be in for a relatively quiet week as Wall Street works its way through a historically difficult September.

item.title: Higher interest rates and AI safety fears put the stock market to the test last week
item.description: Investors wrestled with the prospect of a new Fed rate-hiking cycle and the raging debate on whether to slow down AI.

item.title: Amex launches high-yield savings account to complement business checking
item.description: Amex Business Savings offers an above-average return, plus no minimum balance requirement or monthly fees.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
item.description: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

item.title: Trump's $403 million war chest is finally being spent on the midterms. Now comes the hard part
